description: An address-identifier OPERAND (ISO §2023:8.4.3.1.2 identifier Format 9: the §2023:8.4.3.11 data-address-identifier ADDRESS OF identifier-1 or the §2023:8.4.3.13 program-address-identifier ADDRESS OF PROGRAM ...) outside the SET formats that gate themselves - the CALL argument §2023:14.9.4.3 SR3/SR4 name (kb/Work PB239: bare, BY REFERENCE, BY CONTENT or (Format 2) BY VALUE, always a sending operand that crosses as a detached pointer value), the INVOKE argument §2023:14.9.23.3 SR9/SR19 name (bare, BY REFERENCE, BY CONTENT, and the §2023:8.4.3.4 inline form's argument) and the §2023:8.8.4.2.2 Format 3 relation operand (kb/Work PB1021). Introduced 2002 with the pointer classes. Recognition gate on the addressIdentifier rule, so every future surface that spells the identifier through it is gated automatically.
citation: ISO §2023:8.4.3.1.2 Format 9 (address-identifier) + §2023:8.4.3.11 / §2023:8.4.3.13; §2023:14.9.4.3 SR3/SR4 (the CALL argument); §2023:14.9.23.3 SR9 (the INVOKE argument); §2023:8.8.4.2.2 Format 3 (the relation operand); 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard — Annex E covers 2014→2023 only)
